digest.component_or_area: CI workflow parity test collection subprocess
propositions: _collect_node_ids launches a nested pytest collection subprocess without a private --basetemp, causing its session cleanup to potentially delete or traverse a sibling run's temp tree in the shared numbered root.
pytest session shutdown traverses the shared numbered temp root during cleanup_numbered_dir/rmtree, which can corrupt or stall on another concurrent run's temp tree when --basetemp is not isolated.

The nested collection subprocess must be given a caller-owned private --basetemp directory to prevent cleanup interference while preserving collection selection, stdout parsing, return-code contract, and timeout behavior.

A regression test with a poisoned shared numbered temp root and a preexisting sentinel proves the defect; the fix must cause that test to pass without changing _collect_node_ids signature or output format.
